name: cover-art-search
title: Cover Art Search
description: Search IMDb for movie, TV, anime, and game cover art, copy it, or send it straight to Capacities
author: louay.md

commands.name: search-cover-art
commands.title: Search Cover Art
commands.description: Search IMDb for movie, TV, anime, and game cover art

preferences.name: capacitiesApiToken
preferences.title: Capacities API Token
preferences.description: Optional. Personal access token used to add cover images to your Capacities space. Generate one in the Capacities app under Settings → Capacities API (needs api:read and api:write scopes). Leave blank to use the extension for search and clipboard only.

preferences.name: capacitiesObjectType
preferences.title: Object Type(s)
preferences.description: Choose all object types that should be matched across your Capacities space, separated by commas, exactly as they appear in the app (e.g. Movies, Games).

preferences.name: capacitiesCoverProperty
preferences.title: Cover Property
preferences.description: Name of the property on each object type that should point at the cover image. Default is always 'Cover image'.

preferences.name: capacitiesImageCollection
preferences.title: Image Collection
preferences.description: Optional. Name of an image collection to file the uploaded cover into (e.g. Cover Images).
